text: With the focus of the Clan, mallow, wild garlic, catmint piles, betony, marigold, lungwort, juniper bunches, plantain bundles, mullein, dandelions, horsetail clumps, cobwebs, goldenrod, elder leaf bundles, doses of poppy seeds, blackberry clusters, burdock roots, raspberry clusters, thyme bundles, daisies, moss clumps, oak leaf bundles, ragwort, and tansy were gathered.
